commands.name: Watch This Repository
commands.prompt: The current tab is on github.com. Find the repository as owner/name from the address, open yab://github-release-watch.boost/app/index.html?add=<owner/name> so GitHub Release Watch adds it, and say which repository is now watched. If the tab is not a GitHub repository, say so and stop.

routines.name: Morning Brief
routines.prompt: Morning brief of GitHub releases. Read the repositories I watch on yab://github-release-watch.boost/app/index.html. For each one, read https://api.github.com/repos/<owner>/<name>/releases?per_page=5 and list releases published in the last 24 hours (on Mondays, since Friday morning): repository, version and one line on what changed, with the release link. Group pre-releases at the end. If nothing was released, say so in one line. Do not star, comment or open issues.
